item.title: Myra Elaine Mattila
item.description: With love, we announce the passing of Myra Elaine Mattila. She left us peacefully, with family by her side, on February 15 after a hard-fought battle with neurological disease. Myra is lovingly remembered by her husband, Danny; the families of her sister, Angela, and brother, Mark; and the wide community of friends who knew and loved her.
